Messages.Author: Paul J Paella
Messages.Body:
Hello,
I havn't seen the Giant Blood from Vampire so I'm not sure if they clarified
it or not.

Can you use Giants Blood on an uncontrolled Vampire (one face down with no transfers on him yet) to bring it up to full blood capacity and be ready at the end of the turn?

Scenario: My predator used GB on the first turn on one of his uncontrolled
11 capacity Vamps from the new set and claimed that the Vampire gets all 11
blood and is now ready. Is this right? Has the Vampire card been changed?
Can you tell I'm a newbie? :]

Peace Paul,

You cannot play a master card on an uncontrolled vampire unless the card explicitly
states that you can, so NO, your pred _cannot_ do that.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
pae...@cs.buffalo.edu (Paul J Paella) writes:

>Hello,
> I havn't seen the Giant Blood from Vampire so I'm not sure if they clarified
>it or not.

>Can you use Giants Blood on an uncontrolled Vampire (one face down with no transfers on him yet) to bring it up to full blood capacity and be ready at the end of the turn?

>Scenario: My predator used GB on the first turn on one of his uncontrolled
>11 capacity Vamps from the new set and claimed that the Vampire gets all 11
>blood and is now ready. Is this right? Has the Vampire card been changed?
>Can you tell I'm a newbie? :]

No, the card hasn't changed (except that it can now only be played once
per game). It doesn't say that it may affect an uncontrolled vampire -
therefore it cannot. This is true of both the Jyhad and the VTES versions.
